test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the length of the arc of the sector of a circle of diameter 7 cm with a central angle of 108°. [Use π = 22/7]
solution:
**Given : **

Diameter = 7 cm

Central Angle = 108° 

**Formula Used :**

Length of the Arc = θ/360° × 2πr

**Calculation : **

Length of arc = 108° /360° × 2 × 22/7 × 7/2

⇒ 2 × 11 × 108°/360° 

⇒ 2 × 11 × 12/40

⇒ 11 × 3/5

⇒ 33/5 = 6.6 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6.6 cm.**
